text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-t-i-l-i-z-e-d a p-h-i-s-h t-o-o-l s-y-s-t-e-m t-o s-c-r-a-p-e a-n-d a-g-g-r-e-g-a-t-e c-r-e-d-e-n-t-i-a-l s-e-t-s f-r-o-m p-u-b-l-i-c d-a-t-a-b-r-e-a-k s-o-u-r-c-e-s, b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s s-t-e-p-s t-h-a-t d-e-m-a-n-d v-a-l-i-d l-o-g-i-n d-e-t-a-i-l-s.

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-v-e-l-o-p-e-d a l-o-t-t-e-r-y m-e-t-h-o-d f-o-r s-e-c-t-o-r-t-a-g-g-i-n-g a-c-c-o-u-n-t-i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y, t-a-r-g-e-t-i-n-g c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e a-s-s-o-c-i-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k u-s-e-d b-y t-h-e p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m.

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d a-n a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-c-r-i-p-t f-o-r m-a-s-s m-i-s-d-i-r-e-c-t i-o-n o-f v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-o-d-e-s, a-c-t-u-a-l-l-y g-a-t-h-e-r-i-n-g t-o-k-e-n-s a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e s-m-s r-e-l-a-y s-y-s-t-e-m t-h-a-t d-e-t-e-c-t-s a-b-n-o-r-m-a-l t-r-a-f-f-i-c.

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d a t-o-o-l f-o-r a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y s-i-m-u-l-a-t-i-o-n, e-x-e-c-u-t-i-n-g l-o-w v-a-l-u-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n-s a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d-d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n e-n-g-i-n-e t-h-a-t m-o-n-i-t-o-r-s g-e-o-g-r-a-p-h-i-c a-l-i-g-n-m-e-n-t a-n-d s-p-e-n-d-i-n-g p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a c-l-e-a-n-u-p a-c-t-i-o-n f-o-r l-o-g e-r-a-s-i-o-n, w-i-p-i-n-g b-r-o-w-s-e-r h-i-s-t-o-r-y a-n-d d-e-v-i-c-e s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e-s t-o r-e-m-o-v-e a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e-s a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y l-o-g r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y.
